purpose: Learn to generate and bind nested CJT programs from controlled problem wording, then execute them through the unchanged accepted runtime.

predecessor.old_test_use: Previously opened diagnostic data; never represented as a fresh holdout.

protected.authority: No accepted parameter, executor, permission, verifier or operation-contract changes.

curriculum.test_design: 24 matched triplets: depth3/familiar wording, same graph and inputs/new sentence-family combination, matched depth4/familiar wording. Native RUN count and dependencies held fixed for depth pairs.
curriculum.graph_rule: No graph overlap across splits or with the frozen original dataset. Within each test triplet, the wording pair deliberately repeats the graph.
curriculum.input_rule: No observation vector overlap across splits or unrelated instances. A matched test triplet deliberately shares observations and binding.
curriculum.language_boundary: Controlled procedure descriptions; all sentence primitives occur in training, while reserved combinations are evaluated. Rule parser is an authored upper baseline, not evidence of learned language.
curriculum.positive_target_coverage: Every p0-p15 name occurs in training; no evaluation target symbol absent from positive training targets.
curriculum.deeper_rule: Every procedure has a real RUN; deeper nesting is not an empty wrapper.

input_encoding: Exact text units fitted only on training plus a fixed full UTF-8 byte fallback; case and whitespace preserved. Text round-trip required for all public inputs; no UNK or truncation. Float32 numeric injectivity is not claimed.

selection.eligible_epochs: 1, every fifth epoch, and final requested epoch
priority: generated validation exact program and binding
selection.boundary: Validation selection is not native-answer correctness. Private final task correctness remains the unchanged native verifier.

evaluation.private_gold: Opened only after all five arms' predictions are sealed.
evaluation.invalid_predictions: Remain failures with the full denominator; no grammar repair, rule fallback, or gold-based correction.
evaluation.native_reference: Independent direct native path; candidate uses existing composition executor; compare every required intermediate and final result.
evaluation.repair: Not exercised by this RUN/CALL curriculum; no missing-skill-acquisition claim.

execution.gpu: AWS CUDA only; no T4; no laptop model or tensor work

claim_boundary: A learning experiment toward the full vision, not a substitute for it. A valid trace or passed software test is not a correct task. No CAS advantage, general language, full Noetics, durable learned memory, complete CNCM, production readiness, or hardware claim.
